en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing river traffic on a broad river. In the foreground are moored sailing boats with tall masts and people standing on the quay. In the middle distance are steam or motor vessels with several flags and, to the left, an arched steel bridge spanning the river. Low tree‑covered banks and cloudy sky form the background. Printed captions identify the scene as the Waal at Nijmegen, and the left margin bears the printer's line. A handwritten name or note appears at the bottom.
